_comment: Project-scope MCP config for apex-mcp. Copy (or symlink) this file to the
repository root as .mcp.json to activate it for everyone working in the repo;
it lives here because serve/ owns it. Cursor and Codex read the same schema.
${VAR} expands from the developer's environment when the client starts —
commit the config, never the secret. A required var with no value and no
${VAR:-default} fails to parse, so the password carries a dev default.
